title: Accessibility, Mobile/Input, Performance & Nonblocking Fallbacks
objective: Define deterministic accessibility-equivalent controls, mobile/input adaptation, bounded performance behavior and explicit nonblocking fallback semantics over frozen MAL-01..08 without changing canonical game truth, owner-domain authority or deterministic outcomes.

rules: All raw keyboard, pointer, touch, gamepad, switch and assistive-device input is translated into frozen MAL-02 semantic input before it can affect MAL-local deterministic state.

Accessibility alternatives preserve semantic action equivalence. Alternate controls, hold/toggle equivalence, reduced motion, high contrast and textual cues may not change canonical difficulty, success, timing truth, rewards or owner outcomes merely because an accessible presentation or control path is used.
Raw device identity, operating system, refresh rate, frame timing, wall-clock time, network latency and nondeterministic randomness never become MAL outcome truth.

Performance adaptation may reduce presentation detail or defer nonessential work, but it may not skip, reorder or fabricate deterministic logical ticks, transitions, owner handoffs, permission checks or canonical obligations.

Nonblocking fallbacks are explicit and deterministic. Missing nonessential presentation resources may degrade locally; unavailable essential semantic input, owner references or unresolved Permission state become blocked-local or unresolved rather than guessed or auto-completed.
Unknown, hidden or unauthorized owner-domain state remains unresolved. Fallback behavior may not reveal hidden data, infer secret state or bypass MAL-08 owner/reward boundaries.
The same authorized semantic input, logical tick, MAL-local state and fallback inputs produce the same semantic outcome and deterministic receipt regardless of device or presentation mode.
AI remains proposal-only and may not infer hidden state, commit owner outcomes, alter accessibility equivalence or authorize rewards.
forbidden: accessibility mode changing semantic difficulty or reward truth

invalidation_events: relevant AIOC MAL authority or checkpoint change
required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-09 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
